args.body: Check the existing Stream Commerce exact-draft decision once using permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence. Reuse any recorded decision and any existing pending request for the draft hash. If a new receipt exists, record the precise stage it supports: authorization, send, eligible reply, accepted order, or Treasury settlement. If the decision is still pending or coverage is unavailable, leave the existing handoff in place. Reconsider on a new operator decision or permitted inbound evidence. Do not submit or resend anything.
